learning_outcomes.text: Be able to define engine and driving characteristics
Be able to define Forces and moments acting on the vehicle and Vehicle Aerodynamics
Be able to solve problems related to wheel size calculations
Be able to solve problems related to braking calculations
To have grasped the subjects of solving mathematical problems related to clutch and gearbox

syllabus_topics: Rolling resistance, Acceleration resistance, Air resistance, Transmission resistance, Hill resistance
Vehicle usage characteristics and steering systems
Vehicle skidding and sideslip, oversteer, cornering behavior.
Effect of driving forces on cornering ability, Driving characteristics
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the decision of the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
bibliography: Göktan A., Taşıt Tasarımı, İtü Matbaası, 1992. Otomotiv Bilim Ve Teknoloji Topluluğu Yayınları, Obitet
